enriched_description: Retail storefront with a narrow entrance and large display windows showcasing tobacco products. Interior features wooden shelving and glass display cases filled with cigarettes, cigars, pipes, and pipe tobacco. Counter area has a cash register and humidor for premium cigars. Wall-mounted racks display lighters, rolling papers, and accessories. Signage above the entrance reads 'Tobacconist' or features pipe/cigar imagery. Lighting is warm and subdued. Floor is wood or tile. Overall atmosphere is traditional with dark wood paneling and leather accents.

Hinged oval or rounded-ring seat mounted on top of a toilet bowl. Made from molded plastic (white, off-white) or wood with a smooth glossy finish. Outer dimensions approximately 38-45 cm long, 35-38 cm wide. Inner opening is oval-shaped. Two hinge posts at the rear attach to the toilet bowl. Lid may be attached (closed-front) or separate (open-front commercial style). Surface is smooth and contoured to match the bowl shape. Bumpers on the underside prevent sliding. Color matches the toilet fixture (typically white).

Handheld light source consisting of a long stick or rod with a flaming head. Traditional torches have a wooden or metal shaft (60-120 cm long) with a bundle of flammable material (rags, pitch-soaked wood) at the top producing an open flame. Modern flashlights (British usage) are cylindrical devices 10-20 cm long with a lens at one end and a battery compartment. Lens is clear plastic or glass with a reflector behind it. Body is metal or plastic in black, silver, or yellow. Switch is a sliding or push-button type on the side or end.

Tall carved wooden pillar (3-20 meters) featuring stacked sculpted figures representing animals, mythical beings, and ancestral figures. Carved from a single cedar tree trunk. Figures are painted in bold colors: red, black, white, blue, and green. Each figure has distinctive features: eagle with spread wings, bear with prominent snout, raven with curved beak. Surface shows wood grain and carving tool marks. Figures are stacked vertically with clear separation between each. Base is wider and may be set in a concrete foundation. Top figure is the crest figure.

Heavy-duty truck equipped with a hydraulic boom and winch system for recovering disabled vehicles. Cab is a standard truck cab (flat-nose or conventional). Rear chassis features a rotating boom with a crossbar and hooks. Hydraulic outriggers stabilize the truck during lifting. Flatbed variants have a tilting bed that slides back to ground level. Color is typically yellow, white, or orange with reflective safety striping. Amber warning lights on the roof. Rear has chains, straps, and towing equipment. Overall length 7-10 meters.

Retail storefront with colorful window displays featuring toys, games, and children's products. Large glass windows showcase dolls, action figures, board games, and plush toys arranged at child eye-level. Entrance has a wide doorway with bright signage. Interior features low shelving accessible to children. Aisles are wide and brightly lit. Display stands are shaped like castles, rockets, or other playful themes. Color palette is vibrant: red, yellow, blue, green. Checkout counter is near the entrance. Seasonal displays feature holiday-themed toys.

Heavy-duty agricultural vehicle with large rear wheels (1.5-2m diameter) and smaller front wheels. Cab is enclosed with glass windows and a roll-over protection structure (ROPS). Body is painted in brand colors: John Deere green/yellow, Case IH red, Kubota orange. Engine hood is long and narrow. Rear features a three-point hitch and power take-off (PTO) shaft for attaching implements. Exhaust stack rises vertically from the engine compartment. Overall length 4-6 meters. Tread pattern on rear tires is deep and aggressive for field traction.

Articulated heavy goods vehicle consisting of a tractor unit (cab) connected to a semi-trailer. Tractor has a large cab with sleeper compartment behind the driver's seat. Fifth-wheel coupling connects to the trailer. Trailer is a long rectangular box (12-16 meters) with corrugated metal sides and rear swing doors. Overall length 16-22 meters. Color varies: white, silver, or company-branded liveries. Multiple axles (3 on trailer, 2-3 on tractor). Aerodynamic fairings on the cab roof. Reflective tape along the trailer sides and rear.

Flat shallow receptacle with a raised rim and handles on opposite sides. Shape is typically rectangular or oval. Dimensions range from 30x20 cm (serving tray) to 60x40 cm (large tray). Material is plastic, metal, wood, or melamine. Surface is smooth and may feature printed patterns or a solid color. Rim is 2-5 cm high to prevent items from sliding off. Handles are integrated cutouts or attached grips. Surface shows scratches and wear from repeated use. Used for serving food, carrying documents, or organizing items.

Military-style raincoat made from water-resistant gabardine fabric in khaki, tan, or navy. Length extends to mid-calf or knee. Features include a double-breasted front with 6-10 buttons, a belted waist with a matching fabric belt, epaulettes on the shoulders, and a storm flap over the chest. Deep patch pockets with button flaps at the hips. Sleeve cuffs have adjustable straps. Back has a vent for ease of movement. Raglan sleeves and a gun flap on the right shoulder. Fabric has a smooth slightly glossy finish when wet.
